summary: A docs folder with a second branch that holds different files
description: What branch switch exists for. `main` has the index and one guide; `feat/rendered-diff` has a document `main` has never seen and a different index. The two differ on purpose — a branch holding the same files would let a switch that never touched the working tree pass — so a scenario can check that the explorer and the open document really follow. The repository is left on `main`, which is where a person would find it.
